title: pvExtractAMRBlocks
body:
## pvExtractAMRBlocks

Extracts chosen datasets (boxes) from an AMR input (vtkUniformGridAMR), each identified by its refinement level and its index within that level. The output is a multiblock with one block per level, each holding the extracted uniform grids as pieces. Use it to inspect or process individual AMR patches; pvConvertAMRdatasettoMultiblock or pvResampleAMR convert the whole hierarchy instead.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- SelectedDataSets is a flat list of (level, index) pairs; Schemaxis rejects an odd number of entries.
- Indices restart at 0 on every level; they are not global block numbers.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ExtractAMRBlocks`. Identity: `filters/ExtractHierarchicalDataSets`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Extract Datasets filter. Accepted data: AMR data (vtkUniformGridAMR). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkUniformGridAMR"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SelectedDataSets` | Specify a pair, level and dataset index, for every dataset from the input AMR dataset to extract. Complete tuples of 2 values. | `{"items":{"type":"integer"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvExtractAMRBlocks",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
